mkdir -p programs; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('programs/task-e6ef4731.py')
source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    cw = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    ccw = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [grid[i] + cw[i] for i in range(n)] + [ccw[i] + half[i] for i in range(n)]
'''
p.write_text(source)
# Verify demo and current test output dimensions/shape
ns={}
exec(source,ns)
